text: In 1850 the estate agent Jonathan Harker leaves his wife Lucy in Wismar and [travels to a Transylvanian castle the villagers beg him to avoid|trigger|travelling somewhere remote]. Count Dracula, pale and long-nailed, is enchanted by her portrait and sails for Wismar with his coffins of cursed earth, and [rats pour through the streets as plague takes hold|images|vermin and creeping things]. Weary and unable to die, he [asks Lucy for some of her love|wants|a lover to possess], and she learns that holding him until dawn will [cost her own life|ending|dying to save others].
